# Scorecard app

Follow [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and [app/README.md](../../app/README.md). The app is a small Rayfin overlay with two pages (Overview and Questions) that reads `EvalRuns`, `EvalResults` and `EvalQueries` through the `evals` connector. The old `overlay/` and `standalone/` conventions no longer apply.
